get.description: The planet: grid, heights, biomes, rivers, land loop, sites and places (stored, generated on first request).
Hotspots, hunting grounds, fixed features (nodes, dens, signposts, markers), roads, bridges and flora kinds.
The log seats, stools and mats people sit and lie on, where their slots are, in each site's local metres.

Every usable tree, bush, root patch, reed bed and deadwood pile, packed (layout in `app.world.flora`):
`cell u32[n] | east i8[n] | north i8[n] | kind u8[n] | scale u8[n] | yaw u8[n]`, little-endian, n = bytes / 9.

ClockChange.title: ClockChange
ClockChange.description: Payload of a `clock` engine command (also the admin request body).

Feature.title: Feature
Feature.description: A fixed thing in the wild: a node (seam, fishing spot, waterhole...), a den, a signpost or a claim marker.

Furniture.title: Furniture
Furniture.description: A piece of furniture as the client draws it (`GET /api/v1/world/furniture`).

Ground.title: Ground
Ground.description: A hunting ground around a settlement.

LiveEvent.title: LiveEvent
LiveEvent.description: A public event of interest, sent just before the `tick` message of its tick.

LiveState.title: LiveState
LiveState.description: Where everyone is: on connect (`snapshot`) and after every engine tick (`tick`).

Needs.title: Needs
Needs.description: 0-100: hunger and thirst grow, energy and health run down.

Road.title: Road
Road.description: A road (3 m) or path (1.5 m): an optional lead inside the town chart, then a cell route outside it.

Target.title: Target
Target.description: What an action is about, for spectators (a person, an animal, a node, a store, a place...).

WorldPlaces.title: WorldPlaces
WorldPlaces.description: Hotspots, grounds, fixed features, roads and bridges (`GET /api/v1/world/places`).
